name: Type 1Aide
source:
Follow along with a sophisticated companion robot on deployments, navigating the tribulations of the mortal world and its unique challenges (other mortals).

[From [url=https://the-magic-tuba-pixie.itch.io/type-1aide]Itch.io[/url]]

[摘自[url=https://the-magic-tuba-pixie.itch.io/type-1aide]itch.io[/url]]
